recipes.name: Pizza sauce
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl.
Taste and add more salt or sugar if needed.
For a thicker, deeper sauce, simmer it in a small pot for 10 minutes, stirring. Ask an adult to help.
Let cool before spreading on pizza dough. This covers 2 large pizzas.

recipes.name: Marinara sauce
steps: Warm the olive oil and garlic in a pot over medium low heat for 2 minutes, until the garlic sizzles but does not brown. Ask an adult to help.
Pour in the tomatoes carefully, they may spatter.
Stir in the oregano, salt and pepper flakes.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until a little thicker.
Tear in the basil and taste for salt.

recipes.name: Alfredo sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the garlic for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Pour in the cream and simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes, until a little thick.
Take it off the heat and stir in the parmesan a handful at a time until smooth.
Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Toss with 12 oz (340 g) cooked fettuccine right away. It thickens as it sits.

recipes.name: Brown gravy
ingredients: 4 tablespoons (55 g) butter or pan drippings
2 cups (480 ml) beef or chicken broth
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, whisking, until golden brown.
Slowly whisk in the broth so no lumps form.
Add the Worcestershire and onion powder.
Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, whisking, until thick.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Mushroom gravy
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the mushrooms and onion for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned.
Add the garlic and flour and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly stir in the broth, soy sauce and thyme.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick. Season with pepper.

recipes.name: Teriyaki sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water
steps: Put the soy sauce, water, brown sugar, honey, vinegar, garlic and ginger in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring. Ask an adult to help.
Stir the cornstarch mix again and pour it in.
Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Use on chicken, salmon or stir fries. Keeps in the fridge for a week.

recipes.name: Barbecue sauce
steps: Whisk everything in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, it bubbles and spits.
Simmer on low for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
Let cool. Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Ranch dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill or 1 teaspoon dried
1/4 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Whisk everything together in a bowl.
Add more buttermilk for a thinner dressing, or less for a thick dip.
Chill for 30 minutes so the flavors mix.
Keeps in the fridge for 1 week.

recipes.name: Honey mustard sauce
steps: Put everything in a small bowl.
Whisk until smooth.
Taste and add more honey for sweeter or mustard for tangier.
Great for dipping chicken nuggets and pretzels.

recipes.name: Caesar dressing
steps: Whisk the mayo, parmesan, lemon juice, mustard, Worcestershire, garlic and anchovy paste.
Slowly whisk in the olive oil.
Add water a little at a time until it pours.
Season with pepper. This version uses mayo, so there are no raw eggs.

recipes.name: Balsamic vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Screw the lid on tight.
Shake hard for 30 seconds, until creamy.
Shake again before each use. Keeps in the fridge for 1 week.

recipes.name: Italian dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Close the lid and shake for 30 seconds.
Let sit for 5 minutes so the herbs soften.
Shake again before using.

recipes.name: Thousand Island dressing
steps: Put everything in a bowl.
Stir until smooth and pink.
Chill until ready to use.

recipes.name: Blue cheese dressing
steps: Whisk the sour cream, mayo, buttermilk, lemon juice, Worcestershire and garlic powder.
Stir in the blue cheese, mashing a little of it.
Season with salt and pepper.
Chill for 30 minutes. Great with wings and celery.

recipes.name: Sesame ginger dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Shake hard for 30 seconds.
Use on salads, slaw or cold noodles.

recipes.name: Ginger carrot dressing
ingredients: 1 large carrot (about 100 g), peeled and chopped
steps: Put everything in a blender.
Blend for 30 to 60 seconds, until mostly smooth but still a little chunky.
Pour over iceberg lettuce like at a Japanese steakhouse.
Keeps in the fridge for 5 days.

recipes.name: Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill or mint
steps: Grate the cucumber on a box grater, keeping fingers clear.
Squeeze the grated cucumber in a clean towel to get the water out.
Stir the cucumber into the yogurt with the garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, dill and salt.
Chill for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Cucumber raita
steps: Whisk the yogurt until smooth.
Stir in the cucumber, cumin and salt.
Sprinkle with mint.
Serve cold with curries, biryani or spicy food. It cools your mouth.

recipes.name: Lemon tahini sauce
ingredients: 1/4 to 1/2 cup (60 to 120 ml) ice water
steps: Stir the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt. It will get thick and clumpy. That is normal.
Whisk in the ice water a spoonful at a time.
Keep going until it is smooth, pale and pourable.
Drizzle on falafel, roasted vegetables or salads.

recipes.name: Cheddar cheese sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat and whisk in the flour for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk in the milk and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until it thickens.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the cheese a handful at a time until melted.
Stir in the salt and paprika.
Pour over nachos, broccoli, fries or pasta.

recipes.name: Bechamel white sauce
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until bubbly but not brown.
Pour in the warm milk a little at a time, whisking all the time so no lumps form.
Simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, whisking, until thick enough to coat a spoon.
Season with salt and nutmeg. Stir in grated cheese to make a cheese sauce.

recipes.name: Hot fudge sauce
steps: Put the cream, corn syrup, brown sugar and cocoa in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat, whisking, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat and add the chocolate and butter.
Let sit for 1 minute, then whisk until smooth and glossy.
Stir in the vanilla and salt. Serve warm over ice cream.

recipes.name: Salted caramel sauce
ingredients: 6 tablespoons (85 g) butter, cubed, at room temperature
1/2 cup (120 ml) heavy cream, at room temperature
steps: An adult should make this. Melted sugar is much hotter than boiling water and sticks to skin.
Heat the sugar in a heavy pot over medium heat, stirring with a heatproof spatula, for 5 to 8 minutes, until melted and amber.
Add the butter. It will bubble up hard. Stir until melted.
Slowly pour in the cream while stirring. It bubbles again.
Boil for 1 minute, then take it off the heat and stir in the vanilla and salt.
Let cool for 10 minutes. It thickens as it cools.

recipes.name: Chocolate syrup
steps: Whisk the cocoa, sugar, water and salt in a small pot.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, whisking. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes, until a little thick.
Take it off the heat and stir in the vanilla.
Let cool. It thickens more in the fridge. Stir 2 tablespoons into a glass of milk for chocolate milk.

recipes.name: Strawberry sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water (optional, for thicker sauce)
steps: Put the strawberries, sugar and lemon juice in a small pot.
Simmer over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring and mashing a little, until saucy. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and cook for 1 minute more if you want it thicker.
Serve warm or cold on ice cream, cheesecake or waffles.

recipes.name: Lemon curd
steps: Whisk the lemon juice, zest, sugar and eggs in a heavy pot until smooth.
Add the butter and cook over medium low heat, whisking all the time. Ask an adult to help.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until thick enough to coat a spoon and it reaches 170°F (77°C). Do not let it boil.
Pour through a strainer into a jar.
Press plastic wrap onto the top and chill for 2 hours, until set.

recipes.name: Vanilla custard sauce
steps: Heat the milk and cream in a pot until steaming. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the yolks and sugar in a bowl.
Slowly whisk the hot milk into the yolks, then pour it all back into the pot.
Cook on low, stirring all the time, for 6 to 8 minutes, until it coats a spoon and reaches 170°F (77°C). Do not let it boil.
Strain into a jug and stir in the vanilla.
Serve warm over pies, crumbles and puddings.

recipes.name: Cranberry sauce
ingredients: 12 oz (340 g) fresh or frozen cranberries
1 cup (240 ml) water or orange juice
steps: Stir the sugar and water in a pot over medium heat until the sugar dissolves. Ask an adult to help.
Add the cranberries and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until most berries pop.
Stir in the zest.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then chill for 2 hours. It sets as it cools.

recipes.name: Homemade applesauce
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) apples, about 7, peeled, cored and chopped
1/2 cup (120 ml) water or apple juice
steps: Peel, core and chop the apples. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Put everything in a pot, cover and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the apples are very soft.
Mash with a potato masher for chunky sauce, or blend for smooth.
Serve warm or chilled. Keeps in the fridge for a week.

recipes.name: Sweet and sour sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water
steps: Whisk the pineapple juice, vinegar, brown sugar, ketchup and soy sauce in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cornstarch mix.
Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until thick and shiny.
Use as a dip or toss with crispy chicken.

recipes.name: All-purpose stir fry sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) chicken broth or water
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Close it and shake until the cornstarch dissolves.
Pour into your stir fry for the last 1 to 2 minutes of cooking, stirring until thick and glossy. Ask an adult to help at the hot pan.
Shake again right before using, the cornstarch sinks.

recipes.name: Peanut sauce
ingredients: 1/4 to 1/2 cup (60 to 120 ml) hot water
steps: Put everything except the water in a bowl.
Whisk in the hot water a little at a time until smooth and pourable.
Taste and add more lime or honey.
Serve with summer rolls, noodles, chicken skewers or vegetables.

recipes.name: Spicy mayo
steps: Put the mayo in a small bowl.
Stir in 1 tablespoon sriracha, the lime juice and sesame oil.
Taste and add more sriracha if you want it spicier.
Drizzle on sushi bowls, burgers or fries.

recipes.name: Easy garlic aioli
steps: Stir everything together in a small bowl.
Let sit for 10 minutes so the garlic flavor spreads.
Serve with fries, sandwiches or roasted vegetables. Using mayo means no raw egg.

recipes.name: Tartar sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dill pickle relish or finely chopped pickles
steps: Stir everything together in a small bowl.
Chill until ready to use.
Serve with fish sticks, fried fish or crab cakes.

recipes.name: Shrimp cocktail sauce
steps: Stir everything together.
Start with 1 tablespoon horseradish and add more if you want it stronger.
Chill and serve with cold cooked shrimp.

recipes.name: Special burger sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon pickle juice or white vinegar
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl.
Chill for 30 minutes if you have time, so the flavors blend.
Spread on burgers or use as a dip for fries.

recipes.name: Red enchilada sauce
ingredients: 2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk in the flour and spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring.
Stir in the tomato paste.
Slowly whisk in the broth.
Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, until a little thick.
Stir in the salt and vinegar. Makes enough for one 9 by 13 inch pan of enchiladas.

recipes.name: Salsa verde
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) tomatillos, husks removed and rinsed
1 or 2 jalapenos, seeds removed for mild
steps: Turn on the oven broiler. Ask an adult to help.
Put the tomatillos, onion, jalapenos and garlic on a foil-lined sheet.
Broil for 5 to 7 minutes, until charred, then flip and broil for 5 minutes more.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Blend with the cilantro, lime juice and salt until mostly smooth.

recipes.name: Mango salsa
steps: Have an adult help peel and dice the mango and vegetables.
Put everything in a bowl.
Stir gently.
Serve with chips, fish tacos or grilled chicken.

recipes.name: Taco seasoning
steps: Stir all the spices together in a small bowl.
Store in a jar with a lid.
Use about 2 tablespoons with 1 lb (450 g) cooked ground meat and 1/2 cup water, then simmer for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Buffalo sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) cayenne pepper hot sauce
steps: Put everything in a small pot over low heat. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk for 2 to 3 minutes, until the butter melts and it is smooth.
Toss with wings, cauliflower or chicken tenders.

recipes.name: Honey garlic sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
steps: Melt the butter in a small pot and cook the garlic for 30 seconds. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the honey, soy sauce and vinegar and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cornstarch mix and simmer for 1 minute, until sticky.
Brush on chicken, salmon or shrimp.

recipes.name: Dumpling dipping sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon rice vinegar or black vinegar
steps: Stir the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Add the green onion, garlic and chili oil.
Serve in small bowls for dipping dumplings and spring rolls.

recipes.name: Green mint chutney
ingredients: 1 cup packed cilantro, with tender stems
steps: Put everything in a blender with 2 tablespoons water.
Blend until smooth, scraping down and adding water as needed.
Taste for salt and lemon.
Stir 2 tablespoons into 1/2 cup yogurt for a creamy dip.

recipes.name: Tamarind chutney
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 g) jaggery or packed brown sugar
steps: Put everything in a small pot and stir.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring, until syrupy. It thickens more as it cools.
Let cool and serve with samosas, pakoras and chaat.

recipes.name: Homemade ketchup
ingredients: Pinch of ground allspice or cloves
steps: Whisk everything in a small pot.
Bring to a simmer over medium low heat. Ask an adult to help, it spatters.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often.
Let cool, then chill for 1 hour. Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Dulce de leche
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz / 397 g) sweetened condensed milk
Hot water for the water bath
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pour the condensed milk into a 9 inch pie plate and stir in the salt. Never heat an unopened can, it can burst.
Cover tightly with foil.
Set it in a bigger pan and have an adult pour hot water halfway up the pie plate.
Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes, until thick and caramel brown. Add water to the pan if it gets low.
Whisk until smooth and let cool for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Olive tapenade
steps: Put everything in a food processor.
Pulse 8 to 10 times, scraping down the sides, until finely chopped but not smooth.
Spread on toasted baguette or crackers.

recipes.name: Fruit salsa
steps: Have an adult help dice the fruit small.
Put all the fruit in a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and juice and stir gently.
Serve with cinnamon sugar tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Blueberry syrup
ingredients: 2 cups (300 g) blueberries, fresh or frozen
1 teaspoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water (optional)
steps: Put the blueberries, sugar, water and lemon juice in a small pot.
Simmer over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until the berries burst. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the cornstarch mix for a thicker sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Pour warm over pancakes, waffles or ice cream.

recipes.name: Cinnamon honey butter
steps: Put everything in a bowl.
Beat with a mixer for 2 minutes, until light and fluffy.
Spread on warm rolls, cornbread or sweet potatoes.

recipes.name: Yum yum sauce
steps: Whisk everything together until smooth.
Add water until it drizzles.
Chill for 1 hour so the flavors blend.
Serve with fried rice, grilled chicken and vegetables.

recipes.name: Lemon butter sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Melt 1 cube of butter in a small pan and cook the garlic for 30 seconds. Ask an adult to help.
Add the broth and lemon juice and simmer for 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and whisk in the rest of the butter one cube at a time until creamy.
Stir in the zest, parsley and salt. Spoon over fish, chicken or vegetables.

recipes.name: Poppy seed dressing
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Shake hard for 30 seconds, until creamy.
Pour over spinach salads and fruit salads.

recipes.name: Lemon vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon salt and a pinch of pepper
steps: Put everything in a jar.
Shake until mixed and a little creamy.
Use on greens, grain salads or roasted vegetables.

recipes.name: Lime crema
ingredients: 1 teaspoon adobo sauce from canned chipotles (optional, for chipotle crema)
steps: Whisk everything together.
Add a teaspoon of water if you want it thinner for drizzling.
Drizzle over tacos, burrito bowls and nachos.
